A '''battle''' was fought during the [[Zaarin insurrection]] at [[Serenity (planet)|Serenity]].

==Prelude==
After [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kuuztin]]'s [[Battle of Gwar|disastrous]] mission. [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] decided to use [[Demetrius Zaarin|Zaarin's]] desire to get the latest technological advantage to lure him into an ambush and arranged a [[Convoy/Legends|Convoy]] consisting of two [[Container transport]]s [[Neelie]] and two [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport|''Beta''-class ETR-3 escort transports]] [[Bob 1]] and [[Bob 2]] as bait. Leaking to Zaarin that they contained [[Missile Boat]]s, in reality, they carried munitions, and the only Missile Boat was one piloted by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]. Stele was ordered to ensure that the transports reach [[Hyperspace/Legends|Hyperspace]] and then Thrawn will send a strike force led by his [[flagship]], the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Grey Wolf]]''.

==The battle==
Stele soon moved out of the container transport to engage the [[TIE/Advanced starfighter|TIE Advanced]] star fighters, soon 5 [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|CR92a ''Assassin''-class corvettes]] [[Kormoran group|''Kormoran'']] arrived and began launching [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE Bombers]] after Stele destroyed the 3 TIE Advanced, he provided cover for ''Neelie'' by destroying the bombers until they could reach hyperspace. Once that happened the ''Grey Wolf'' arrived with 3 [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike cruisers]] [[Formidable (Strike-class)|''Formidable'']], [[Indomitable (Strike-class)|''Indomitable'']] and [[Triumph (Strike-class)|''Triumph'']]. The ''Grey Wolf'' began to launch bombers at the corvettes, which began to retreat to hyperspace. Stele, under the orders of the [[Prophets of the Dark Side|Secret Order]] made a quick sweep of the corvettes to find each had no cargo, and helped the Bombers destroy the corvettes before they could escape.

==Aftermath==
Although a victory for Thrawn, it wasn't the result he was hoping for. Zaarin had deliberately committed a minor force with no attempt to capture. This was likely because Zaarin had [[Spy/Legends|Spies]] in the Empire and relayed to him the information about the trap. Thrawn decided to try again, this time with more tempting bait.

==Behind the scenes==
This battle appears in ''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'' in Battle 11, Mission 3. This article assumes completion of "Primary", "Secondary" and "Bonus" Goals completed.
